The '''Askaj system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Rimma Trade Route ran through the system, far off from which was the planet Askaj. Living on the planet were a [[Species/Legends|species]] called Askajians who worshiped the planet's one moon, Moon Lady, as a deity. The major orbital body of the system was the planet Askaj. The system was under the administration of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilkadon]] whose oppression forced many inhabitants to relocate to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The planet was later liberated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] some time after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
